theorem _root_.GlobalTheory.exists_noetherian_subring_homogeneous_matrix_flat_charts :
    ∀ (ι : Type) [LinearOrder ι] [Fintype ι] (R : Type) [CommRing R] (a b : ℕ) (d : Fin a → ℤ) (e : Fin b → ℤ) (Φ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) (MvPolynomial ι R)), (∀ l j, Φ l j ∈ _root_.GlobalTheory.polyGrading ι R (e j - d l)) → (∀ i : ι, ∃ (B : Type) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra R B) (π : MvPolynomial ι R →ₐ[R] B) (P : Type) (_ : AddCommGroup P) (_ : Module B P) (ε : (Fin a → MvPolynomial ι R) →ₛₗ[(π : MvPolynomial ι R →+* B)] P), Algebra.Smooth R B ∧ Module.Projective B P ∧ Function.Surjective π ∧ π (X i) = 1 ∧ Function.Surjective ε ∧ ∀ y, ε y = 0 ↔ ∃ w w', y = Φ.mulVec w + (X i - 1 : MvPolynomial ι R) • w') → ∃ (R₀ : Subring R) (Φ₀ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) (MvPolynomial ι R₀)), IsNoetherianRing R₀ ∧ Φ₀.map (MvPolynomial.map R₀.subtype) = Φ ∧ (∀ l j, Φ₀ l j ∈ _root_.GlobalTheory.polyGrading ι R₀ (e j - d l)) ∧ ∀ i : ι, Module.Flat R₀ (QuotSMulTop (X i - 1 : MvPolynomial ι R₀) ((Fin a → MvPolynomial ι R₀) ⧸ LinearMap.range Φ₀.mulVecLin))

theorem exists_noetherian_model_grCube (ι : Type) [LinearOrder ι] [Fintype ι] (R : Type)
    [CommRing R] (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [Module R G] [Module (MvPolynomial ι R) G]
    [IsScalarTower R (MvPolynomial ι R) G] (𝒢 : ℤ → Submodule R G) [PolyGradedSMul ι 𝒢]
    [Decomposition 𝒢]
    (H : ∀ i : ι, ∃ (B : Type) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra R B)
      (π : MvPolynomial ι R →ₐ[R] B) (P : Type) (_ : AddCommGroup P) (_ : Module B P)
      (ε : G →ₛₗ[(π : MvPolynomial ι R →+* B)] P),
      Algebra.Smooth R B ∧ Module.FinitePresentation B P ∧ Module.Projective B P ∧
        Function.Surjective π ∧ π (MvPolynomial.X i) = 1 ∧ Function.Surjective ε ∧
        ∀ n, ∀ y ∈ 𝒢 n, ε y = 0 →
          ∃ k : ℕ, (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial ι R) ^ k • y = 0) :
    ∃ (R₀ : Subring R) (_ : IsNoetherianRing R₀) (C₀ : Cube.{0} ι R₀)
      (θ : Cube.baseChange R C₀ ⟶ grCube ι 𝒢 0),
      (∀ I : Finset ι, I.Nonempty → Module.Flat R₀ (C₀.obj I)) ∧
        (∀ p, Module.Finite R₀ ((cechComplex C₀).homology p)) ∧
        ∀ I : Finset ι, I.Nonempty → Function.Bijective (θ.app I).hom
